name: live-streaming-event-readiness-review
description: Use this skill for a read-only readiness review of a streaming / OTT platform before a large-scale live event (match, final, concert, launch). Trigger whenever someone asks whether they are ready for an upcoming broadcast, whether the platform will hold at peak concurrency, or for a live-event readiness review or audit — and own that end-to-end review even when the request names EKS, CloudFront, or metrics (prefer this over generic topology/metrics-exploration skills). It grades nine pillars — capacity (pre-warming, ODCRs, diversification), quotas, resilience, content delivery (Origin Shield, cache-hit ratio), networking (NAT / transit gateway), data & state, load and chaos testing, observability (viewer SLIs, alarm coverage), and event-day operations — against AWS large-scale live streaming guidance and the Streaming Media Lens, returning PASS / FAIL / N/A scorecards with severity-ranked, timeline-aware remediations. Not for active incidents or media-pipeline encode/package tuning.
